prompts.woman_heads:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel-art HEAD VARIANT ATLAS for a customizable dating-game avatar. Image1 is the APPROVED CHARACTER DESIGN: use the WOMAN only, exactly her attractive adult face, chestnut wavy hair color, warm brown eyes, skin tone, and refined pixel illustration quality. DO NOT redesign into a different face, vector cartoon, child, plastic doll, or smooth painting. Her visible earrings and necklace must be removed completely in this base asset.
Output one square sprite atlas, exactly FIVE COLUMNS by FIVE ROWS =25 isolated HEADS. Every head is front-facing at the identical angle, size and position within its equal cell. Same face/eye/chin coordinates throughout. Only HAIRSTYLE changes by COLUMN and facial EXPRESSION by ROW. Include the complete hair silhouette and face ending at the chin, with at most a tiny neck stub. NO shoulders, clothing, earrings, necklace, hands, accessories, text, labels, grid lines, floor or shadows. Keep generous empty gutters. All cells have the SAME HEAD SIZE; do not enlarge short hairstyles to fill their cells.
COLUMNS, left to right: 1. shoulder-length flowing waves with curtain bangs like approved woman; 2. lovely short layered pixie cut with side fringe; 3. chin-length softly rounded bob with side bangs; 4. tidy high bun with soft face-framing wisps; 5. very short elegant buzz/pixie crop, clear hairline, NOT bald. All chestnut brown, same woman, the same adult facial proportions, visibly distinct hair silhouettes. Long hair hangs beside face with the center below chin EMPTY for separately layered clothing.
ROWS, top to bottom: 1. gentle warm closed-mouth smile; 2. bright friendly open smile with small tasteful teeth; 3. cool, quietly confident subtle smile with relaxed narrower eyes, not angry; 4. curious/interested raised eyebrow and softly parted lips, not sad; 5. blink: BOTH eyes naturally CLOSED, gentle closed-mouth smile, otherwise identical face. Blink is a real eyelid closure, no open eyes. Repeat these five expressions for ALL five hairstyles.
Pixel art production style exactly matching approved image: fine deliberate square clusters, warm highlights and restrained cool shadows, carefully drawn anime eyes, clean selective outlines, rich but controlled colors. No white sticker rims. Approx 2500x2500 pixels so faces stay detailed. BACKGROUND MUST BE A SINGLE PERFECTLY SOLID CHROMA GREEN #00ff00 everywhere outside the heads, including all gutters and the empty center below the long hair. This green is a removable technical matte; no green may appear in hair/face. No checkerboard, gradient, background scene or decor. 25 complete heads, no cropping. This is a game asset, not a presentation with borders.

Atlas exactly4 COLUMNS x3 ROWS=12 complete headless clothed bodies. Equal cells and generous gutters. Do not crop shoes or hands.

Outside bodies pure solid #00ff00 chroma-key green, no checkerboard, no text/labels/borders, no ground or baked shadows. Exactly12headlessbodies.
